messages:
pagerbot: Paging: p95/p99 inference latency spike in us-west-2 serve pool. Error: 'GPU allocation failures'. Severity: P1. @Devon (oncall) you're up.

Devon (oncall): on it, joining bridge. seeing gpu allocation errors in the autoscaler logs. posting link to live metrics: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/serve/us-west-2-pool

Carla M.: I see client retries increasing, some dedicated customers getting 503s. customers: acme-inc, fitlytics. Not yet on support noise but ramping.

Devon (oncall): incident-bot create incident --title "us-west GPU shortage causing latency + 503s" --severity P1 --owner devon

incidents-bot: Incident RINF-2026-045 created (bridge + paging). Runbook: https://wiki.redwood/internal/runbooks/gpu-shortage. Please annotate customer impact.

Alice K.: quick triage: autoscaler appears to be failing to provision new thin-provisioned GPU nodes; error: "quotaExceeded: cannot create GPUs in us-west-2-az-b". Could be cloud quota or regional capacity.

Ben R.: confirming with cloud account team now. Also starting regional failover: routing policy -> set prefer-region=us-east-1 for affected model routes. Command I used: ```sh
redwoodctl routing set --model llama-13b --policy fallback:us-east-1 --force
```

Devon (oncall): good. Deploybot shows routes updated to include us-east preference. Adding fallback window: 30m. Will monitor error rates.

Carla M.: note: enable temporary throttling at API layer to reduce retries. Suggested config: `rate_limit: 50req/s per-org` for acme-inc and fitlytics. Who can flip that?

Alice K.: I can push a ruleset to gate. Pushing now. ```yaml
- org: acme-inc
  rate_limit: 50
- org: fitlytics
  rate_limit: 50
```

Devon (oncall): action items so far: 1) regional failover active (Ben) 2) rate-limits applied (Alice) 3) cloud quota check (Ben) 4) customer comms draft (Carla) 5) create remediation ticket (Devon). I'll create a post-incident tracker.

Devon (oncall): created tracker ticket: https://jira.redwood/browse/RINF-3245 -> title: "us-west GPU capacity shortage - remediation runbook & quotas". Assigned to Ben, due EOD+3.

Ben R.: cloud says we hit soft limits in us-west for A100 count, provisioning is delayed 2-4 hours today. They've offered temporary placement group in us-west-2b but not guaranteed. I'm opening support case.

Carla M.: Customer impact note for postmortem: 503s and elevated latency for a subset of requests (mainly streaming). No long-term data loss. Need to confirm exact span and affected customers for postmortem.

Devon (oncall): scheduling postmortem meeting. Proposed time: tomorrow 1400 PT. Anyone object?

Alice K.: ok for me. I'll bring logs and autoscaler trace.

Ben R.: ok. I'll bring cloud support ticket details and quota numbers.

Carla M.: I'll prepare the customer impact summary + support interactions. Also creating a short status update for affected customers now. Draft: "We experienced transient service degradation in us-west-2 between 14:22 and 15:03 PT due to GPU allocation delays; traffic was routed to fallback region where applicable. We're investigating." Thoughts? :eyes:

Devon (oncall): good draft. Post it to #customer-status once Ben confirms failover numbers.

sre-runbook-bot: Runbook step executed: "Enable regional fallback" by Ben R. Timestamp logged.

Ben R.: update: cloud accepted support escalation. They've increased soft quota by +40 GPUs in us-west-2 for next 24h. Provisioning is in progress (tracking id: cloud-req-8891).

Carla M.: support update posted to customers and support ticket. No elevated escalation from enterprise TAMs yet.

Devon (oncall): moving to mitigation->remediation handoff: We'll track short-term remediation in RINF-3245 (Ben owner). Long-term action items in RINF-3302 (capacity planning). Assigning owners here:
- Ben R. -> cloud quota & procurement (RINF-3245)
- Alice K. -> autoscaler resiliency checks + unit tests (RINF-3302)
- Carla M. -> customer comms & postmortem writeup (RINF-3303)
- Devon (oncall) -> postmortem facilitator + timeline (RINF-3304)

Devon (oncall): please add estimated ETA fields to those tickets. We'll include a retro runbook change: add automated cross-region warm pool when thin-provisioning fails.

Alice K.: noted. I'll prototype the warm-pool gating change and post a PR to infra repo: https://git.redwood/infra/proposals/warm-pool-gating

Ben R.: I've added initial remediation checklist to RINF-3245: 1) confirm cloud quota increase 2) drain & reprovision evacuated nodes 3) validate KV cache warmup after failover 4) update autoscaler fallback thresholds

Carla M.: postmortem note: we should include latency vs token-cost tradeoffs for future failovers (we saw increased egress costs on us-east).

Devon (oncall): agreed. Also want a follow-up to measure customer error budgets impact: assign to SRE analytics.

Ben R.: I'll update RINF-3245 with progress tonight. Current status: cloud quota granted (partial), provisioning ongoing, routing fallback stable.

Devon (oncall): closing the live bridge. Move to async remediation tracking. We will reconvene in postmortem meeting tomorrow. Thanks all. :tada:

Carla M.: quick checklist before closing: postmortem invite sent, include stakeholders: product, infra, support, ops. Done.

Alice K.: leaving final note: autoscaler logs attached to the ticket (links). Also adding test to CI to fail if allocation error rate > 0.5% per hour during deploy.

Devon (oncall): final: labeling this thread as "remediation-tracking" and linking to JIRA RINF-3245 / RINF-3302 / RINF-3303 / RINF-3304. If anything else crops up, ping me direct.

pagerbot: Incident RINF-2026-045 resolved (mitigation: regional fallback + quota increase). Timeline: 14:22-15:03 PT. Postmortem scheduled: tomorrow 14:00 PT.

Carla M.: reaction :white_check_mark: — I'll start drafting action items for the postmortem doc.

Ben R.: reaction :rocket: — will update tickets tonight.

Devon (oncall): thanks team.
